title: From Combat Medic to Software Engineer: Translating a Non-Traditional Background

cover.alt: An unmarked field pouch and bandage connect by a documentation ribbon to an electronics diagnostic tray.

figures.title: The operational loop that carried over
figures.summary: The article connects past experience to present engineering behaviors.

items.label: Assess
items.detail: Identify the problem and its scope before acting.

items.label: Stabilize
items.detail: Address the immediate issue with a focused intervention.

items.label: Hand off
items.detail: Communicate the current state to the next person or team.

items.label: Document
items.detail: Record what happened, what was tried and what worked.

figures.caption: A reflection on transferable work habits, not medical guidance or a claim that the two roles are interchangeable.

figures.title: Make the transition inspectable
figures.summary: Pair an engineering claim with an artifact another person can examine.

items.label: Troubleshooting
items.detail: Lab notes and logs show the path from symptom to diagnosis.

items.label: Systems work
items.detail: A repository and deployment show how components connect.

items.label: Team contribution
items.detail: Pull requests and issues show bounded changes and review.

items.label: Communication
items.detail: Write-ups explain the failure, fix and remaining limits.
